name: Broadway Subway
description: Millennium Line extended from VCC–Clark to Arbutus (Broadway Subway). Uses the future track already in OpenStreetMap near Great Northern Way plus a sketched alignment under Broadway (custom-track.geojson: approximate, ±20 m). Station positions are approximate. Every Millennium trip ending at VCC–Clark continues to Arbutus; trips starting there start from Arbutus. Run times are estimated from distance. The 99 B-Line ends at Arbutus instead of continuing along Broadway. Buses are schedule-only in scenarios.

operations.$note: The 99 B-Line is cut back to Arbutus station instead of paralleling the subway along Broadway (Braden, 2026-09-26).
